notes.title: Forest Home Update
notes.content:
We hope you've had a happy holidays! Our first update fixes an issue where some players were unable to obtain achievements for completing 500 and 750 levels.

If you have already completed the criteria for these achievements, simply complete a level (previously completed levels will work as well) in the new update and the achievements will retroactively unlock!
